reasoning: Sample-efficient LLM/benchmark evaluation via active sampling and uncertainty-based acquisition is a crowded, well-developed area: Active Testing (2021), AcTracer, Factorized Active Querying (5x fewer queries with coverage guarantees), and embedding-based uncertainty sampling that is ~5x more cost-efficient all do essentially this, and GPs are a standard uncertainty-aware surrogate. The proposal's only differentiator is applying a GP-over-sentence-embeddings + variance acquisition to estimate an overall *safety* score to +-1%, which is a thin domain wrapper on an established method rather than a methodological gap. Very close prior work exists, so largely_addressed.
